description: Family order used by VASCULUM CheckList. Listed families are sorted phylogenetically from earlier-diverging lineages to later-diverging lineages; genera and lower ranks are sorted alphabetically within families.

sources.citation: PPG I. 2016. A community-derived classification for extant lycophytes and ferns. Journal of Systematics and Evolution 54:563-603.

The Angiosperm Phylogeny Group. 2016. An update of the Angiosperm Phylogeny Group classification for the orders and families of flowering plants: APG IV. Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society 181:1-20.
sources.scope: angiosperms; extend this file with APG IV family placements as needed
